title.en: boutiques gifting edition at the f1 pit building.
title.de: boutiques gifting edition im f1 pit building.
title.tr: f1 pit building'de boutiques hediyelik pazarı.

line.en: around three hundred brands under one roof, 11:00 to 21:00. indoors, so the afternoon rain does not matter. go early and walk the stalls.
line.de: rund dreihundert marken unter einem dach, 11:00 bis 21:00. drinnen, der regen stört nicht. früh kommen und die stände durchgehen.
line.tr: tek çatı altında yaklaşık üç yüz marka, 11:00'den 21:00'e. kapalı alan, öğleden sonraki yağmur sorun olmaz. erken gelip standları gezin.
